about_the_game:
Following a nuclear fallout, a new Rome rises from the ashes. Likewise, a new colosseum is born. Whisked away from the wasteland as a child, you, like many others, have been trained especially for the arena. Battle other Gladiators, unlock new weapons, abilities, as you rise the ranks.

Accept your role, and assert your position as a powerful, notorious, Gladiator. Experience the spoils of victory. Or, reject your occupation, inspect your past, challenge the powers that be…

The game takes place in waves. Defeat enemies, collect XP, and progress to the next wave, at which point you will level up. In Gladiators of Roma Revixit, you are presented with 4 upgrade options. In addition, you must select from four negative conditions. To defeat your foes, you must strike a strategic balance between the two when leveling up.

  • Couch play

Battle your friends in the colosseum locally.

  • Vast, Unique Enemies

Each enemy is unique, with their own attacks and abilities, adding interesting dynamics at every turn. With a wide ensemble of such enemies, and unique bosses, playability is almost endless.

  • Rich Story

Gladiator’s of Roma Revixit features a rich story and lore to explore, with complex characters and themes. Who knew, the bombs weren’t the end of the world after-all.

content_descriptors.notes: This game is set in a bleak and dark world, with dark themes and not-so-great-people. While it won't be over the top for most people, it's not meant be all sunshine and rainbows, but everything has a purpose in the narrative in this regard.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 and above
  • Processor: Intel Core 4th generation or similar
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 520 or similar
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Gladiators of Roma Revixit is a unique, story-driven roguelike, set in world in which, after the nuclear fallout, a new Rome and thus a new colosseum rises from the radioactive-ashes. Rise the ranks, enjoy the celebrity of being a Gladiator, and make decisions that impact the story.
